section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants and procedure for a study involving first-year college women. A pre-college sample of 94 White older adolescent females, admitted to a southeastern U.S. university, completed an online survey. After excluding 10 participants due to missing data, the final sample size for Study X was 84, with a mean age of 17.9 years and a mean BMI of 22.7.
